candidates.en: Because the most common type of speech – face-to-face conversations – is highly interactive, this mode is well suited to many social contexts, such as casual conversations over lunch, business transactions in a grocery store, discussions between students and teachers in a classroom.
candidates.zh: 最常见的口语形式——面对面交谈——具有很强的互动性，因此很适用于许多社交情境，例如午餐时闲聊、杂货店里的买卖交流，以及课堂上师生之间的讨论。
